messages.body: Professional is an advanced stage. Move steadily and keep your notes tidy.
Complex topics become clear with patient, repeated reading.
Rest well before long study days. Clear thinking needs it.
Apply provisions to case situations. That is how Professional is tested.
Attempt drafting and case questions regularly, not only at the end.
Revise the high-weight topics first, then the rest.
You are near the finish of a long professional journey. Be proud.
Every module you complete is proof of your commitment.
The end is in sight. Keep enjoying the progress you are making.
